name: @hl-bos/transformation-intelligence
description: HL-BTI v2 — the reusable Business Transformation Intelligence engine. A composition layer over @hl-bos/bti-engine (scoring, findings, consulting) and @hl-bos/catalog (Software Factory) that turns a scored assessment into executive recommendations answering: what happened, why, what to do, the estimated business impact, and what approval is required. Configurable scoring, no hardcoded industries, nothing fabricated.
